zh.title: 共軍建總統府模型 國防部：掌握情報籲支持國防預算
zh.summary: 外媒報導共軍建造台灣總統府及蘇澳軍港模型，國防部發言人孫立方中將表示國軍已完整掌握情報並研擬敵可能行動應變措施，並強調此事凸顯台灣面臨嚴峻敵情威脅，呼籲全民支持國防預算以獲取建軍備戰資源。
body: 外媒報導，共軍打造台灣總統府、蘇澳軍港模型。
國防部發言人孫立方中將表示，國軍已完整掌握情報並研擬敵可能行動的應變措施。
孫立方並強調，此事凸顯台灣面臨嚴峻敵情威脅，呼籲全民支持國防預算，讓國軍獲得資源建軍備戰。
美國「財經內幕」（Business Insider）今天引述英國「每日電訊報」（The Telegraph）分析衛星影像所作報導指出，中國不只建造美國軍艦的複製品，也打造戰機和台灣總統府、蘇澳海軍基地等建築模型。

en.title: PLA builds models of Taiwan presidential office, Su'ao base; MOA urges defense budget
en.summary: The People's Liberation Army has constructed scale models of Taiwan's Presidential Office and the Su'ao naval base, according to foreign media reports cited by Business Insider and The Telegraph. Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Sun Li-fang confirmed that the armed forces have complete intelligence on the matter and have prepared appropriate response measures. Sun emphasized that the development underscores the severe security threat facing Taiwan and called on the public to back the defense budget so the military can secure the resources needed for training and readiness.
body: Foreign media reported that the PLA built models of Taiwan's Presidential Office and the Su'ao naval port.
Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Sun Li-fang said the military has fully grasped intelligence and prepared response measures for possible enemy actions.
Sun also stressed that the situation highlights the severe threat Taiwan faces and urged the public to support the defense budget so the military can obtain resources for building and training.

Business Insider, citing The Telegraph's satellite analysis, reported that China not only builds replicas of U.S. warships but also constructs models of fighter jets, Taiwan's Presidential Office and the Su'ao naval base.

zh.title: 國防部長澄清漢光無本島實彈 總統視導不影響演訓
zh.summary: 國防部長顧立雄澄清漢光42號演習期間台灣本島無實彈射擊計畫，總統賴清德視導行程不會干擾部隊正常演訓
body: 漢光42號實兵演習將於8月5日起一連10天9夜實施。
聯合報報導，「漢光演習安排總統賴清德視導實彈，挨批作秀」。
國防部長顧立雄會前受訪澄清，媒體報導內容並非屬實，因為軍方沒有規劃漢光期間於台灣本島實施實彈射擊，也不會為了賴總統的視導行程刻意實施實彈科目。
顧立雄強調，有關賴總統的其餘視導行程並不會影響部隊正常演訓。
他指出，賴總統身為三軍統帥，本來就要了解部隊演訓並慰勞官兵，「但演訓科目、驗證項目不會受到視導行程有所影響」。

en.title: Defense Minister Clarifies No Live-Fire on Taiwan During Han Kuang; Presidential Visit Won’t Affect Exercise
en.summary: Defense Minister Gu Li-xiong said the Han Kuang 42 live‑troop exercise starting August 5 will not include any live‑fire on Taiwan proper, and that President Lai Ching‑te’s observation visit will not disrupt regular training. He added that the president, as commander‑in‑chief, is expected to observe and encourage troops, but exercise subjects and verification items will remain unchanged.
body: The Han Kuang 42 live‑troop exercise will run for ten days and nine nights beginning August 5.
United Daily News reported that the exercise was arranging for President Lai Ching‑te to observe live‑fire, drawing criticism of a show.
Minister Gu Li‑xiong clarified that the report is untrue because the military has no plan for live‑fire on Taiwan during Han Kuang, nor will it schedule live‑fire events for the president’s visit.
Gu emphasized that the president’s other observation itineraries will not affect normal unit training.
He noted that as commander‑in‑chief the president should understand training and morale troops, but exercise subjects and verification items will not be influenced by the visit.
